_schema: A station with no canvases in it at all, which is the only one. Everything the shape requires is here and `canvases` is empty; the runtime gives such a station a share of tau measured in seconds -- pacing.beat -- because there is no paint for a burst rate to be a rate of, and refuses to advance through it for pacing.hold on the way in.
title: The strokes stop
_canvases: Empty, and that is the station. DESIGN 7: no ear, no blood, no razor -- the painting simply stops mid-canvas, the brush cuts, and the scrub refuses to advance for a beat. The restraint is the entire effect and it will be tempting to ruin. M8 owns making it land and expects to get it wrong twice; what M6 owes it is that the arc runs through here without leaving the piece, and that the date on the band is the right one when it does.
_ground: The primed cloth of station 0 and nothing on it. There is no swell because there is no plain: the two stations either side are six hundred metres away in both directions and this is the middle of the road.
_pacing: beat is how many seconds of tau this station is, and it is the only station whose share of the axis is a duration rather than a stroke count. hold is how long the scrub refuses to move on the way in. Both are guesses and both are meant to be argued with at M8; they are here so that there is something to argue with.
_letter: There is no letter for this and there should not be one.

caption.title: 23 December 1888
caption.sub: Nothing is painted here. The scrub stops for a beat and then goes on, and the next canvas is on rougher cloth in another town.
